title: Aggrega Dependency Lockfile (Manifest)
description: A single, global lockfile that maps abstract Developer Interfaces to concrete Ops Implementations via O(1) dictionary lookups based strictly on Instance Names.

version.description: Strict Semantic Versioning of the manifest lockfile (e.g., 1.0.0).

description.description: A concise, one-sentence summary of what the entity does.

maintainers.description: List of maintainers who own this entity.

repository.description: The URL to the Git repository where the source files live.

home.description: The URL of this entity's home page, wiki, or documentation.

keywords.description: A list of descriptive keywords for UI discoverability.

defs.description: Optional block for standard YAML anchors (& and *) to keep the Manifest DRY while maintaining a flat O(1) dictionary for the compiler.

spec.description: The Manifest's mapping declarations plus optional base inheritance: mappings connects abstract component and feature types to concrete Recipe and FeatureRecipe implementations; extends inherits mappings from a base Manifest.

extends.description: URI of a base Manifest to inherit mappings from. Child mappings safely overwrite the base to support frictionless local dev loops.

mappings.description: Maps abstract interfaces to concrete implementations. Two authoring shapes are accepted: (a) the flat shape, with reserved top-level keys 'components' and 'features' mapping component-type / feature-type URIs directly to Recipe / FeatureRecipe URIs (recommended; capability-agnostic at the Manifest layer — capability determination flows from each resolved Recipe's spec.capability at orchestrator-time); (b) the legacy per-provider shape, with top-level keys naming providers (e.g., 'helm', 'compose'), each provider section carrying its own components / features sub-sections. The flat shape takes precedence when both are present in the same Manifest.

components.description: Flat-shape component-type to Recipe URI mapping. A Recipe URI carries at most two segments — an optional leading capability, then the recipe name — plus an optional version; a reference with a third segment matches no recipe. Version forms: exact ('postgres-bitnami:1.2.0'), range ('postgres-bitnami:^1.2.0'), or unversioned ('postgres-bitnami'); the resolver pins the resolved version in the lockfile at first resolve. A reference may additionally be capability-qualified ('terraform/mariadb-rds:1.0.0', the segment before the first '/' naming the recipe's spec.capability) — required when more than one recipe ships the same name; an ambiguous bare reference halts resolution loudly rather than silently picking one.

features.description: Flat-shape feature-type to FeatureRecipe URI mapping. Includes both operational Features and credential Features (labeled feature.aggrega.ai/kind: secret).

additionalProperties.description: Legacy per-provider mapping section (e.g., 'helm', 'terraform', 'compose'). Any key other than the reserved 'components' and 'features' names a provider section.

features.description: Maps Feature types to FeatureRecipe URIs. Includes both operational Features and credential Features.

mapping_tier.description: Two-tier resolution: 'type' maps by catalog type (DRY bulk), 'name' maps by instance name (granular override). Both are optional but at least one must be present. Name wins over type during resolution. Versioned type keys win over unversioned.

type.description: Maps catalog type URIs to Recipe URIs. Supports versioned keys ('core/api-server:1.0.0') for exact match, range keys ('core/api-server:^1.0.0') for major-compatible match, or unversioned keys ('core/api-server') for any-version match.

name.description: Maps specific instance names to Recipe URIs. Takes precedence over type-based mapping.

annotations.description: Annotation-driven Feature shortcuts. Maps annotation keys to a Feature URI plus a pillar-grouped routing table from dotted-path subkey to Feature pillar (values or infra). Validation derives from the target Feature's spec.schema.<pillar>.<dotted-path> declaration; the binding declares routing only. The Feature URI referenced by 'feature' MUST also appear in the 'type' section (that is where the FeatureRecipe version binding lives).

feature.description: Feature URI this annotation routes to. The Feature is looked up in the catalog; its spec.schema declares the validating types for each routed subkey path.

maps.description: Pillar-grouped subkey-path routing table. At least one of infra: or values: must declare at least one path. Paths use dotted notation to navigate nested Feature schema properties (e.g., 'ingress.host' addresses the schema's ingress sub-object's host property).

infra.description: Subkey paths routing to the Feature's infra pillar. Paths are dotted identifier sequences; each path must reference an existing property in Feature.Spec.Schema.infra.

values.description: Subkey paths routing to the Feature's values pillar. Paths are dotted identifier sequences; each path must reference an existing property in Feature.Spec.Schema.values.
